x9n3g7:289: The significance of NTM lies not only in performance improvement but also in revealing the root cause of why few-step sampling fails in diffusion models: existing few-step methods implicitly assume that the denoising process can be compressed, but this assumption conflicts with the probabilistic foundations of diffusion models. NTM resolves this fundamental contradiction by introducing the expressive power of normalizing flows. Specifically, the reverse process of a standard diffusion model is modeled as: $p_\theta(x_{t-1}|x_t) = \mathcal{N}(\mu_\theta(x_t), \sigma_\theta(x_t))$. When the number of steps is very small, this Gaussian assumption is overly simplistic and cannot capture the complex structure of the data distribution. NTM replaces each reverse step with an invertible transformation $f_\theta(x_{t-1}|x_t)$, preserving the expressive capacity of the distribution.
